item.title: Episode 1: Basic Skip Silence Test
item.description: Short test episode with basic silence patterns - 150ms, 250ms, and 300ms silence periods for testing skip silence thresholds
item.itunes:summary: Short test episode with basic silence patterns

item.title: Episode 2: Extended Skip Silence Test
item.description: Long-form test episode with extended audio segments and silence periods - perfect for testing skip silence functionality over longer durations with 150ms, 250ms, and 300ms silence intervals

item.title: Episode 3: Random Pattern Skip Silence Test
item.description: Test episode with randomly varying audio segments and silence periods - realistic patterns with audio segments under 2 seconds and random silence durations from 120ms to 350ms

item.title: Episode 4: Extended Random Pattern Skip Silence Test
item.description: Comprehensive 15-minute test episode with extensive random audio segments and silence periods - realistic patterns with audio segments under 3 seconds and random silence durations from 100ms to 400ms for thorough skip silence testing
item.itunes:summary: Comprehensive 15-minute test episode with extensive random audio segments and silence periods

item.title: Episode 5: New Extended Random Pattern Skip Silence Test
item.description: Advanced 15-minute test episode with new random audio segments and silence periods - enhanced patterns with audio segments up to 3 seconds and silence durations of at least 500ms for comprehensive skip silence validation
item.itunes:summary: Advanced 15-minute test episode with new random audio segments and silence periods
